usage.enRule: We use he for a man or a boy.
We use she for a woman or a girl.
We use it for an animal or a thing.
We use you in the singular and plural.
usage.uzRule: 'sen' va 'sizlar' — ikkalasi ham 'you'. Ingliz tilida farqi yo'q.

usage.enRule: We use they for people, animals or things.
usage.uzRule: Ko'plik — odam, hayvon va narsa uchun bir xil 'they'.

rule.noteEn: We always write I with a capital letter.
rule.noteUz: MUHIM: 'I' (men) HAR DOIM katta harf bilan yoziladi — gap o'rtasida bo'lsa ham. Bu o'zbek tilida yo'q qoida, shuning uchun eng ko'p unutiladi.
rule.extraUz: O'zbekchada 'u' bitta so'z, inglizchada esa uchta: he (erkak) / she (ayol) / it (narsa-hayvon). Odam haqida 'it' deyish qo'pol hisoblanadi.

rule.explanationUz: 'to be' — 'bo'lmoq' fe'li. Egaga qarab 3 xil shaklga kiradi: am / is / are.
rule.noteEn: We use short forms in spoken English or in informal written English.
rule.noteUz: Qisqa shakl (I'm, he's) og'zaki nutqda va norasmiy yozuvda ishlatiladi. Rasmiy hujjatda to'liq shakl yoziladi.

rule.explanationUz: So'roqqa 'ha/yo'q' deb javob berganda butun gapni takrorlamaymiz — qisqa javob ishlatiladi.

keyRules.enRule: We use the long form of the verb to be in positive short answers.
keyRules.uzRule: TASDIQ qisqa javobda TO'LIQ shakl ishlatiladi.
keyRules.correct: Are you from Sweden? — Yes, I am.
keyRules.whyUz: Qisqartma gap oxirida turolmaydi. Shuning uchun 'Yes, I'm' xato.

keyRules.enRule: We use the short form of the verb to be in negative short answers.
keyRules.uzRule: INKOR qisqa javobda QISQA shakl ishlatiladi.
keyRules.correct: Are you from Spain? — No, I'm not.
keyRules.whyUz: Inkorda qisqartma tabiiy: I'm not, he isn't, they aren't.

rule.explanationUz: a/an — 'bitta, qandaydir' ma'nosidagi so'z. O'zbek tilida bunday so'z YO'Q, shuning uchun uni tushirib qoldirish eng ko'p uchraydigan xato.

rules.enRule: We use a/an before singular nouns.
rules.uzRule: a/an faqat BIRLIKDAGI ot oldidan qo'yiladi.

rules.enRule: We use a before consonant sounds (/b/, /k/, /d/ etc).
We use an before vowel sounds (/a/, /e/, /o/ etc).

rule.warningUz:
DIQQAT: qoida HARFGA emas, TOVUSHGA bog'liq.
• an hour — 'h' yozilgan, lekin o'qilmaydi (aur) → unli tovush → an
• a university — 'u' yozilgan, lekin 'yu' deb o'qiladi → undosh tovush → a
Shuning uchun so'zni ko'rib emas, ESHITIB tanlang.
rule.pluralNoteUz: Ko'plikda a/an ISHLATILMAYDI: 'They are teachers' (a teachers emas).

exercises.instructionEn: Work in two teams. Take it in turns to choose words from the list and make sentences. Each correct sentence gets one point. The team with the most points is the winner.
exercises.instructionUz: Ikki jamoaga bo'linib ishlang. Navbat bilan ro'yxatdan so'z tanlab, gap tuzing. Har to'g'ri gap 1 ball. Ko'p ball to'plagan jamoa g'olib.
exercises.explanationUz:
Bu Unit 1 ning butun lug'atini takrorlash o'yini. Ilovada siz bir jamoa bo'lasiz — so'z beriladi, siz gap tuzasiz.
Har so'zga mos qolip:
• musician, job, capital → 'X is a musician' (a/an kerak)
• years old → 'He's forty years old'
• where → 'Where is he from?'
• married, pleased → sifat, a/an olmaydi

tasks.answer: Cairo is the capital of Egypt.

exercises.instructionEn: Use the pictures from the Photo File section and write sentences, as in the example.

exercises.explanationUz:
Qolip: MASHHUR JOY + be + in + SHAHAR, MAMLAKAT.
Ko'plik bo'lsa 'are', birlik bo'lsa 'is':

• The Eiffel Tower IS in Paris, France.
Shahar avval, mamlakat keyin — vergul bilan ajratiladi.

exercises.instructionEn: You are a foreign student at Mortimer College. You are responsible for the college magazine and this is the first page of the first issue. Introduce yourself to the readers. Start with: Hello! I'm ... . Then, introduce some of the teachers who work at the college. Start with: This is ... . He/She is ... . Use the information from Ex. 20 and the pictures from the Photo File section, as well as a picture of yourself.
exercises.instructionUz: Siz Mortimer kollejida chet ellik talabasiz. Kollej jurnaliga mas'ulsiz va bu birinchi sonning birinchi sahifasi. O'zingizni tanishtiring: 'Hello! I'm ...'. So'ng kollejda ishlaydigan o'qituvchilarni tanishtiring: 'This is ... . He/She is ...'.
exercises.explanationUz:
Ikki qismli yozma ish:
1) O'ZINGIZ haqingizda — birinchi shaxsda (I'm ...)
2) BOSHQALAR haqida — uchinchi shaxsda (He's/She's ...)
Qolip bir xil: ism → qayerdan → yosh → kasb.
Eng ko'p xato: uchinchi shaxsda 's' ni unutish va a/an ni tushirib qoldirish.

tasks.answer: Hello! I'm Aziz. I'm from Tashkent, Uzbekistan. I'm sixteen years old and I'm a student at Mortimer College.
This is Mary Stuart. She's from Dublin, Ireland. She's thirty years old and she's an English teacher.

exercises.instructionEn: Use the information from the table below to write a short paragraph about Juliet. Use text A in Ex. 16 as a model.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi jadvaldagi ma'lumotdan foydalanib Juliet haqida qisqa matn yozing. Ex. 16 dagi A matnini namuna qilib oling.
exercises.explanationUz:
Namuna matn (A) tuzilishi — aynan shu tartibda yozasiz:
1) This is + ISM.
2) He's/She's from + SHAHAR, MAMLAKAT.
3) ISM + is + YOSH + years old.
4) He's/She's + a/an + KASB.
5) His/Her favourite sport is + SPORT.

Juliet — ayol, shuning uchun She's va Her ishlatiladi.
'waitress' — 'w' undosh → A waitress.

tasks.answer: This is Juliet. She's from Paris, France. Juliet is twenty-two years old. She's a waitress. Her favourite sport is tennis.

exercises.instructionEn: Read this sentence. What does it mean?
exercises.instructionUz: Bu gapni o'qing. U nimani anglatadi?
exercises.explanationUz:
Ma'nosi: har bir notanish odam kelajakdagi do'st bo'lishi mumkin — shuning uchun tanishishdan qo'rqmang. Unit 1 mavzusiga (tanishuv) mos hikmat.
Grammatik jihatdan: 'you haven't met yet' — Present Perfect, keyingi darslarda o'rganiladi. Hozircha ma'nosini tushunish yetarli.

tasks.en: A stranger is a friend you haven't met yet.
tasks.uz: Notanish odam — bu siz hali uchrashmagan do'stingiz.

wordFormation.explanationUz: Fe'lga yoki otga -er qo'shilsa, o'sha ishni qiluvchi odam chiqadi. Agar so'z -e bilan tugasa, faqat -r qo'shiladi.
Ko'pincha san'at va fan sohalarida ishlatiladi.
Millat nomi mamlakat nomidan yasaladi, lekin qo'shimcha har xil bo'ladi — shuning uchun ularni juft holda yodlash kerak. Ikkalasi ham KATTA harf bilan yoziladi.
Ko'pchiligiga -th qo'shiladi: four → fourth. Faqat 3 tasi butunlay boshqacha: one → first, two → second, three → third. Yozilishi o'zgaradiganlari: five → fifth, nine → ninth, twelve → twelfth.
Bir xil o'zakdan ikki xil son yasaladi. Farqi URG'UDA: thirTEEN (13) — urg'u oxirida; THIRty (30) — urg'u boshida. Eshitganda shu bilan ajratasiz.
Ex. 8 dagi jadval aynan shu qoida ustida. Qo'shimchalar: -ian, -ish, -ese, -an. Ikkalasi ham katta harf bilan.
Ex. 10 va 11 da millat nomlari ishlatilgan. Ularni mamlakat nomi bilan juft holda yodlang.
Qisqartmada tushib qolgan harf o'rniga apostrof (') qo'yiladi. Bu so'z yasalishining bir turi:
Ex. 13 dagi 12 ta mamlakatning millat shakli:
Ish yoki joydan uni bajaruvchi yasaladi.
San'at va fan sohalarida. Ikkalasi ham unli bilan boshlanadi → an.
Ko'pligi -men bo'ladi.
Ba'zi so'zlar uzun shaklidan qisqartirilgan.
Ingliz tilida ismlarning qisqa (erkalash) shakli keng tarqalgan. 'Please call me ...' iborasi bilan aytiladi.
O'qituvchi kasbi 'FAN + teacher' shaklida aytiladi. Artikl FAN nomining tovushiga qarab tanlanadi:
Buyuk Britaniya 4 qismdan iborat — har birining o'z millat nomi bor.
To'liq shakldan qisqa shakl yasash — apostrof tushib qolgan harfni bildiradi.
Bu sahifadagi kasb nomlari shu qo'shimchalar bilan yasalgan. Artikl tanlashda foydali: 'a' yoki 'an' — birinchi TOVUSHGA qarang.
Ish yoki soha nomiga -er/-or qo'shiladi.
Ba'zi kasblar -man bilan tugaydi. Ko'pligi -men bo'ladi: postman → postmen.
Ko'pincha san'at va fanda.
Musiqa asbobidan uni chaluvchi odam yasaladi. Ba'zilari -ist, ba'zilari -er oladi — yodlab qo'yish kerak.
Ba'zi kasblarning ayol shakli -ess bilan yasaladi. Diqqat: bular unli tovush bilan boshlansa 'an' oladi.
Kattasi va bolasi butunlay boshqa so'z bo'lishi mumkin.
Sport turi yoki harakatdan uni bajaruvchi yasaladi. Qo'shma so'z bo'lsa, chiziqcha bilan yoziladi.
Ex. 9 da uchragan millat nomlari. Ba'zilari butunlay boshqa so'zga aylanadi.
Ikki so'z birikib bitta ma'no beradi. Artikl birinchi so'zning tovushiga qarab tanlanadi.
Oddiy sonlarga -th qo'shiladi. Lekin -y bilan tugaganlar (o'nliklar) -IETH oladi: y → ieth.
Qo'shimchalar: -ish, -ian, -ese, -an. Ba'zilari qoidasiz.
Ex. 1 dagi mantiq: buyum kasbni bildiradi.
Bu sahifada aynan shu sonlar uchraydi. Uchta so'zning o'zagi o'zgaradi:
Ex. 7 dagi 9 ta mamlakatning millat shakli:
Ba'zi so'zlarda yozilgan harf va o'qiladigan tovush mos kelmaydi. Aynan shular xatoga sabab bo'ladi:
Odam nomlari — ko'pligi qoidasiz bo'lganlari:
Ba'zi kasblarning ayol shakli -ess bilan yasaladi. Hozirgi ingliz tilida ko'pchiligi eskirib bormoqda, lekin 'waitress' hali ham keng ishlatiladi.
Kimningdir narsasini aytishning ikki yo'li:
Sport turiga 'player' qo'shilsa, o'sha sport bilan shug'ullanuvchi chiqadi. LEKIN bu KASB degani emas!

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I'm a musician.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Kasb oldidan a/an ARTIKLI shart. 'I'm musician' — xato. Unli tovush bilan boshlansa an: an artist.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They are farmers.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Ko'plikda a/an ISHLATILMAYDI, lekin so'zga -s qo'shiladi: farmer → farmers.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He's from Edinburgh, Scotland.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'from' — dan. Shahar avval, mamlakat keyin, vergul bilan ajratiladi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I'm forty years old.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'years old' qo'shilishi kerak. 'I'm forty' ham to'g'ri, lekin to'liq shakli — 'forty years old'.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Where is he from? / How old is he?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: So'roq gapda fe'l EGADAN OLDIN keladi: 'is he', 'he is' emas. So'roq so'zi (Where, How old, What) eng oldinda turadi.

sentencePatterns.formula: EGA + be + MILLAT. + EGA + be + from + SHAHAR, MAMLAKAT.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Paolo is Brazilian. He's from Brasilia, Brazil.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Paolo braziliyalik. U Brazilia shahridan, Braziliyadan.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Millat oldidan a/an KERAK EMAS: 'He is Brazilian' (a Brazilian emas). Lekin kasb oldidan kerak: 'He is a musician'. Shu ikkisini adashtirmang.

sentencePatterns.formula: SO'ROQ: Where is + JOY? → In + MAMLAKAT. It's the capital of + MAMLAKAT.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Where is Cairo? — In Egypt. It's the capital of Egypt.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Qohira qayerda? — Misrda. U Misrning poytaxti.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'capital of' — ...ning poytaxti. 'the' artikli shart: THE capital.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She's from Mexico.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Fe'l egadan KEYIN, ikkinchi o'rinda.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They aren't from Egypt.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'not' fe'ldan keyin qo'shiladi va odatda qisqaradi: are not → aren't.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Is he from Mexico?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Fe'l va ega O'RIN ALMASHADI — bu ingliz tilidagi asosiy so'roq qoidasi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: How old are you? / What is your favourite sport?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: So'roq so'zi (How old, What, Where) eng oldinda, keyin fe'l, keyin ega.

sentencePatterns.formula: QISQA JAVOB: Yes, EGA + be. / No, EGA + be + n't.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Yes, she is. / No, she isn't.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: MUHIM: tasdiq javobda qisqartma ISHLATILMAYDI. 'Yes, she is' to'g'ri, 'Yes, she's' XATO.

sentencePatterns.formula: BIRLIK: Is + the JOY + in + MAMLAKAT? → Yes, it is. / No, it isn't. It's in ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Is the Eiffel Tower in Italy? — No, it isn't. It's in France.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Eyfel minorasi Italiyadami? — Yo'q. U Fransiyada.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Bitta narsa → 'it' olmoshi → is / isn't.

sentencePatterns.formula: KO'PLIK: Are + the JOY + in + MAMLAKAT? → Yes, they are. / No, they aren't. They're in ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Are the Pyramids in Brazil? — No, they aren't. They're in Egypt.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Bir nechta narsa → 'they' olmoshi → are / aren't. 'the Pyramids' -s bilan tugagani uchun ko'plik.

sentencePatterns.formula: Are you from + MAMLAKAT? → Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Are you from Egypt? — Yes, I am.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Tasdiq javobda 'Yes, I am' — 'Yes, I'm' XATO. Inkor javobda esa qisqaradi: 'No, I'm not'.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I'm Alison, by the way. What's your name?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Ism oldidan a/an QO'YILMAYDI. 'by the way' — mavzuni o'zgartirganda ishlatiladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Where are you from? → I'm from + JOY.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Where are you from? — I'm from Scotland.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'from' savolda oxirida, javobda esa joydan oldin keladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: What's your job? → I'm + a/an + KASB.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What's your job? — I'm a doctor.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Kasb oldidan a/an SHART.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Patrick, this is Lucy. She's my friend from America.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Patrick, bu Lucy. U mening Amerikadan kelgan do'stim.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Uchinchi shaxsni tanishtirish qolipi. 'This is' — odam uchun ham ishlatiladi (bu yerda 'bu kishi' ma'nosida).

sentencePatterns.formula: Nice / Pleased to meet you. → ... , too.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Pleased to meet you, Lucy. — Pleased to meet you, too.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Javobda 'too' qo'shiladi — 'men ham' ma'nosida. 'Nice to meet you' va 'Pleased to meet you' bir xil ma'no.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Mr Potter, this is Mr Jackson.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Rasmiy vaziyatda familiya oldidan Mr/Mrs/Ms qo'shiladi. Avval kimga tanishtirayotganingizni aytasiz, keyin kimni.

sentencePatterns.formula: O'ZINI TANISHTIRISH: I'm + TO'LIQ ISM, but please call me + QISQA ISM.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I'm Gillian Jones, but please call me Gill.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Men Gillian Jones, lekin meni Gill deb chaqiravering.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Norasmiy muloqotga o'tish usuli.

sentencePatterns.formula: PROFIL (3 gap): This is X. He's/She's from SHAHAR, MAMLAKAT. He's/She's YOSH years old and he's/she's a/an KASB.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: This is Mary Stuart. She's from Dublin, Ireland. She's thirty years old and she's an English teacher.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu Mary Stuart. U Dublindan, Irlandiyadan. U o'ttiz yoshda va ingliz tili o'qituvchisi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Unit 1 ning yakuniy qolipi — barcha o'rganilgan narsa shu uchta gapda. Yozma ishda ham shu ishlatiladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: O'ZI HAQIDA: Hello! I'm X. I'm from ... . I'm ... years old and I'm a/an ... .
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Hello! I'm Rashid Al Hibb. I'm from Alexandria, Egypt. I'm sixteen years old and I'm a student.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Salom! Men Rashid Al Hibb. Men Aleksandriyadan, Misrdan. Men o'n olti yoshdaman va talabaman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Yuqoridagi qolipning birinchi shaxsdagi varianti. Farqi: he's/she's o'rniga I'm.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He's a dancer. / She's an artist.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Kasb aytilganda a/an SHART. Tovushga qarab a yoki an.

sentencePatterns.formula: be + EGA + ... ?  →  Yes, EGA + be. / No, EGA + be + n't.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Is he from China? — Yes, he is. / No, he isn't.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Tasdiqda to'liq (he is), inkorda qisqa (he isn't).

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Is Julie a dancer? / Are you from Canada?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Fe'l birinchi o'rinda. Kasb oldidan a/an, mamlakat oldidan from.

sentencePatterns.formula: JAVOB: No, EGA + isn't/aren't/'m not. + EGA + 's/'re/'m + TO'G'RISI.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: No, she isn't. She's a teacher.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Avval inkor qisqa javob, keyin to'g'ri ma'lumot. Ikkinchi gapda qisqartma ishlatiladi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She's 15. / He's single. / They're from Japan.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U 15 yoshda. / U bo'ydoq. / Ular Yaponiyadan.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Yosh, sifat va mamlakat oldidan a/an QO'YILMAYDI. Faqat birlikdagi OT oldidan qo'yiladi (a teacher, an artist).

sentencePatterns.formula: TAXMIN + TUZATISH: Is/Are + ... ? → No, ... isn't/aren't. ... 's/'re + TO'G'RISI.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Are they policemen? — No, they aren't. They're doctors.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Uch qismli: savol → inkor → to'g'ri javob. Ex. 7 ning butun mantiqi shu.

sentencePatterns.formula: TANISHUV: My name is ... . What's your name?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: My name is Jane Smith. What's your name?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Mening ismim Jane Smith. Sizning ismingiz nima?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'My name is' — to'liq; 'What's' — qisqartma. Ism oldidan a/an QO'YILMAYDI.

sentencePatterns.formula: KASB SO'RASH: Are you + a/an + KASB?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Are you an actress? — No, I'm not. I'm a singer.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Kasb oldidan a/an SHART. Tovushga qarang: an actress, a singer, a guitarist.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Where are you from?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: MUHIM: 'from' gap OXIRIDA qoladi. O'zbekchada 'qayerdan' bitta so'z, inglizchada esa 'Where ... from' ikkiga bo'linadi.

sentencePatterns.formula: What + is + the capital of + MAMLAKAT?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What is the capital of Denmark?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'the capital of' — o'zgarmas ibora, 'the' tushmaydi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: How old is he? — He's 32.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'How old' ikki so'z birga so'roq so'zi bo'lib keladi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: We are not Portuguese. / I am not Dutch.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Biz portugal emasmiz. / Men golland emasman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'not' HAR DOIM fe'ldan keyin. Millat oldidan a/an qo'yilmaydi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He is an artist. / She is a doctor.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Artikl kasbning birinchi TOVUSHIGA qarab: an artist, an astronaut, a doctor, a pilot.

sentencePatterns.formula: What nationality + be + EGA? → EGA + be + MILLAT.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What nationality is she? — She's American.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: MUHIM: millat oldidan a/an QO'YILMAYDI. 'She's American' (an American ham mumkin, lekin bu yerda sifat sifatida ishlatilyapti). Millat nomi katta harf bilan.

sentencePatterns.formula: How old + be + EGA? → EGA + be + SON + years old.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: How old is Richard? — Richard is twenty-four years old.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Richard necha yoshda? — Richard yigirma to'rt yoshda.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Savolda faqat 'old', javobda esa to'liq 'years old'.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He's twenty-six years old.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Son SO'Z bilan yoziladi. 'years old' tushib qolmasin. Aralash son chiziqcha bilan.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Athens is in Greece.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Mamlakat oldidan odatda 'the' yo'q. Istisno: the Czech Republic, the USA, the UK, the Netherlands.

sentencePatterns.formula: Hi, I am + ISM. I am + a/an + KASB.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Hi, I am George. I am a pilot.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Ism oldidan artikl YO'Q, kasb oldidan BOR.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: This is my friend, Mary.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Odamni tanishtirishda 'This is' ishlatiladi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Mary and I are neighbours.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: MUHIM XATO MANBAI: 'X and I' — bu IKKI kishi, ya'ni 'we'. Shuning uchun ARE ishlatiladi, 'is' emas. Qo'shma ega doim ko'plik.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: How old are you? / Where are you from?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: ENG MUHIM QOIDA. Fe'l egadan OLDIN keladi. 'How old you are' — XATO. Skanerdagi o'quvchi buni 3 marta xato qilgan.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: This is Juliet. She's from Paris, France. Juliet is twenty-two years old. She's a waitress. Her favourite sport is tennis.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu Juliet. U Parijdan, Fransiyadan. Juliet yigirma ikki yoshda. U ofitsiantka. Uning sevimli sporti — tennis.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Unit 1 ning YAKUNIY ko'nikmasi: jadvaldagi ma'lumotni 5 ta gapga aylantirish. Tartib: ism → joy → yosh → kasb → sevimli sport.

sentencePatterns.formula: TANISHTIRISH: X, this is Y. He's/She's my friend from + MAMLAKAT.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: John, this is Cindy. She's my friend from Canada.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: John, bu Cindy. U mening Kanadadan kelgan do'stim.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Uchinchi shaxsni tanishtirish. Javob: 'Pleased to meet you.' → 'Pleased to meet you, too.'
